title: Analista De Crm E Lifecycle (Hubspot)
description:
A Monte Bravo nasceu em 2010, do sonho dos nossos sócios fundadores Pier Mattei e Filipe Portella e, desde então, busca fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas através do Mercado Financeiro. Para isso, procuramos unir uma equipe de especialistas para olhar atentamente o patrimônio de cada cliente.

Em 2024, nos tornamos uma das maiores corretoras independentes de investimento do Brasil.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time como Analista de CRM e Lifecycle (HubSpot), nossa missão é oferecer uma jornada fluida e integrada aos nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas digitais. O foco está em aumentar a adesão ao modelo Fee-Based, aumento de SoW e Captação e potencializar a retenção da base através de comunicações inteligentes. Você será o arquiteto das nossas réguas de relacionamento, garantindo que a estratégia se transforme em execução técnica impecável e dados confiáveis.

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em estratégias de CRM, Lifecycle ou Growth Marketing.
  • Domínio avançado de HubSpot.
  • Capacidade de traduzir objetivos de negócio em fluxos lógicos de automação.
  • Perfil analítico com foco em organização de processos e integridade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de teste e validação de hipóteses.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Tableau ou PowerBI) e experiência no mercado financeiro.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica do HubSpot: Administrar e configurar o ecossistema, garantindo a saúde da base, organização de propriedades e fluxos internos.
  • Desenho e Execução de Jornadas: Planejar e implementar fluxos de automação que impactem o ciclo de vida do cliente, desde o onboarding até a maturação no modelo de fee.
  • Interface de Conteúdo: Atuar em conjunto com o time de Redação, fornecendo briefings claros para as réguas de automação e garantindo a implementação correta do copy no HubSpot.
  • Experimentação e Growth: Propor e executar hipóteses de testes A/B em canais (E-mail e In-App) para otimizar métricas de conversão e engajamento.
  • Estruturação para BI e Dados: Garantir a total rastreabilidade das iniciativas (padronização de UTMs e nomenclatura de campanhas), preparando o terreno para análises profundas em ferramentas de BI.
  • Higiene e Qualidade da Base: Executar a segmentação técnica e higienização constante dos contatos, garantindo que a base esteja pronta para escala.
  • Mensuração e Insights: Elaborar relatórios de performance de CRM, monitorando KPIs de funil e extraindo insights para otimizar o calendário de campanhas.
  • Remuneração competitiva ao mercado.
  • TotalPass – Academia e saúde do corpo onde você quiser.
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino conveniadas.
  • Programa VIK – Incentivo à saúde física e mental de forma leve e gamificada.
  • OnHappy – Descontos em passagens, hospedagens e experiências.

Etapas do processo

  • Inscrição
  • Retorno aos demais candidatos

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
Would you enjoy being the quality focal point for complex subsea projects, ensuring requirements are met from fabrication through delivery?

Would you like to act as the main interface between customers, suppliers and project teams within a global energy technology company?

Join our Quality Team!

At Baker Hughes, Quality is fundamental to our project execution success. Our Project Quality professionals ensure that customer requirements, regulatory standards and internal quality processes are fully integrated and consistently applied throughout the project lifecycle, both in-house and at supplier facilities.

Partner with the best!

As a Project Quality Engineer, you will report with a solid line to the Regional Quality Manager and a dotted line to the Product Line Quality Manager. You will be responsible for ensuring the effective application of the Baker Hughes Quality Management System (QMS) and customer requirements across the assigned project scope, acting as a key quality representative toward customers, execution teams and suppliers.

Responsibilities

Project Quality Planning & Execution

  • Implementing quality requirements into product specifications and ensuring compliance at fabrication and execution locations.
  • Establishing the Project Quality Plan, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and related quality documents to guide proper execution.
  • Leading the Go / No-Go process for fabrication start and facilitating pre-production meetings.
  • Ensuring adherence to Product Line directives for standard quality requirements at fabrication sites.

Audits, Inspections & Controls

  • Performing frequent product quality audits, inspections and quality walks to ensure project requirements are properly flown down.
  • Running quality meetings with internal and external stakeholders to cover all product and project quality aspects.
  • Supporting and collaborating in supplier quality records (Manufacturing Record Book – MRB) approval processes.
  • Implementing and monitoring Project Quality KPIs related to MRBs, non-conformances, and punch lists.

Customer & Stakeholder Interface

  • Acting as the primary point of contact for customers on all quality-related aspects of the project.
  • Interfacing with customer site representatives, second- and third-party inspectors during execution, including inspection notifications.
  • Collaborating with product delivery teams to identify, track and close punch-list items.

Problem Solving, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Auditing technical requirements and implementing controls to ensure compliance.
  • Ensuring project Lessons Learned are properly captured, addressed and communicated to Project Management and Product Delivery teams.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in Mechanical, Production or Petroleum Engineering.
  • Have advanced proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across different countries and regions.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements related to the fabrication of subsea equipment, including XTs, Manifolds and Tooling.
  • Have experience supporting or conducting quality audits for customer project assessments.
  • Have strong fundamentals in product quality inspection, testing and documentation analysis.
  • Have solid experience interfacing directly with customers.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills with proven interpersonal effectiveness.
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams or initiatives of moderate scope and impact.
  • Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously with strong organizational discipline.
  • Effective problem identification and solution mindset with analytical rigor.
  • Knowledge and application experience with FMEA methodologies.

Working Patterns

  • 7am-4pm OR 8am-5pm, following manufacturing site activities.
  • Location: Macaé, RJ OR Curitiba, PR.

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programs.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Specialist – QA Engineering

Buscamos um(a) profissional estratégico e com forte capacidade de execução para liderar nossa jornada de expansão. Resiliência e Agilidade: Capacidade de gerir múltiplas frentes simultâneas em um ambiente dinâmico.

title: Administration Officer, OPEN SOCIETY FOUNDATIONS
description:
Reporting To: Manager, General Counsel

Location: London, Nairobi, or Rio de Janeiro

Contract Type: Full Time

Workstyle Arrangement: Hybrid

Department: Office of the General Counsel (OGC)

Team Name: Corporate Secretariat and OGC Operations

Role Purpose

The role of Administration Officer sits within the Corporate Secretariat and OGC Operations division. OGC Operations supports the Office of the General Counsel in a wide range of administrative and executive support tasks, including contract administration, supplier payment processes, intake and resource management, learning and communications, continuous process improvement and optimization as well as housing the Corporate Secretariat function responsible for governance support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work in OGC’s Legal Support Team providing high level legal, executive, and administrative support tasks requiring discretion and confidentiality.
  • Provide proactive administrative support to the Deputy General Counsel (based in Berlin, Germany), including complex calendar management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and expense reporting.
  • Assist senior leaders and attorneys with administrative functions including coordinating schedules, planning complex stakeholder meetings/events, preparing materials, and arranging logistics.
  • Perform legal tasks under supervision and follow compliance-related processes, requiring familiarity with legal vocabulary but not legal practitioner expertise.
  • Provide general administrative support for the OGC including contract administration, procurement processes, invoicing, department spend tracking, coordination of team meetings, scheduling, and assistance with travel and expenses, and other administrative duties.
  • Build and establish relationships with other multi-regional operational departments within OSF. Take notes in meetings and support project management as required.

Qualifications

  • A level of education that, when combined with your professional experience, adequately shows you have the capability to perform the key responsibilities and contribute to organizational success.

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience as a highly skilled administrator and/or executive assistant supporting senior leaders including extensive international diary management and group meeting arrangements. It will be an asset if the experience has been within a law firm or in a legal department.
  • Experience leading and managing a wide range of tasks and/or projects.
  • Experience of administering contracts and managing invoices.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working in a complex international structure and/or the non-profit field.
  • Familiarity with legal concepts and vocabulary.
  • Project Management experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 tools, with experience using digital systems such as CRM platforms, SharePoint, document management systems, trackers, or similar tools.

Functional Competencies

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365, CRM tools, and digital organization platforms, including the ability to use technology to organize work, track priorities, manage information, and improve administrative processes.
  • Exposure to Compliance requirements to ensure the organization adheres to laws and regulations.
  • Demonstrated ability to use verbal and written communication to deliver support for multiple professionals (within a legal team environment), including in the virtual environment.
  • Ability to handle information with the utmost confidentiality.

Personal Competencies

  • Demonstrates commitment to OSF’s core values of humility, commitment, collaboration, respect, inclusivity and integrity.
  • Strong analytical mindset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills enabling relationship building at various levels within and outside the organization, with sensitivity to cultural differences.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness and self-motivation, able to work independently and solve problems creatively.
  • Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion by recognizing and responding positively to individual and group differences in the workplace and beyond. Building an inclusive workplace by respecting and seeking out diverse viewpoints and perspectives.

Languages

An excellent knowledge of English. Knowledge of other languages would be an asset.

Travel

Travel is required and travel frequency depends on the role requirements.

What we offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
  • Staff are required to work in an Open Society office 50% of working days per month.
  • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

description:
A Coop – Cooperativa de Consumo está em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Marketing – Branding e Campanhas (Varejo) para integrar nossa equipe. Como a maior cooperativa de consumo da América Latina, a Coop valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão, acreditando que diferentes experiências e perspectivas fortalecem nosso time e impulsionam nosso crescimento.

Prezamos pela excelência no atendimento ao cliente e pela eficiência em nossas operações, e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem desses valores e queiram contribuir para o sucesso da nossa cooperativa.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente inclusivo, diverso e plural.

Sobre a vaga

A posição é responsável pelo planejamento, coordenação e execução do calendário sazonal e institucional da marca, incluindo o digital institucional, garantindo a correta implementação das campanhas nos canais físicos e digitais, com consistência de marca, eficiência operacional e foco em resultados.

Missão do Cargo

Planejar, coordenar e executar o calendário sazonal e institucional da marca, incluindo o digital institucional, assegurando a correta implementação das campanhas nos canais físicos e digitais, com consistência de marca, eficiência operacional e foco em resultados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e executar o calendário anual de campanhas sazonais e institucionais, garantindo alinhamento com as estratégias da marca e do negócio;
  • Coordenar o desdobramento das campanhas nos canais físicos e digitais, incluindo lojas, PDV, mídia, CRM e canais digitais institucionais;
  • Garantir a padronização da comunicação e o correto uso da identidade visual da marca em todas as ativações;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas Comercial, Operações, Trade, Merchandising e Digital, assegurando execução consistente no ponto de venda;
  • Coordenar campanhas institucionais, datas-chave do varejo e ações de relacionamento com clientes e cooperados;
  • Gerir cronogramas, orçamento, fornecedores e agências, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e controle de custos;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) das campanhas e do digital institucional, propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Apoiar a gerência na organização de processos, rotinas e prioridades do time.

Indicadores de Desempenho (KPIs)

  • Cumprimento do calendário e dos prazos das campanhas;
  • Qualidade e consistência da execução nos canais físicos e digitais;
  • Engajamento e percepção de marca;

  • Controle de orçamento e ROI das ações.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em marketing de varejo, preferencialmente em varejo alimentar e/ou drogaria;
  • Conhecimento em campanhas sazonais, comunicação institucional e execução no ponto de venda (PDV);

  • Capacidade de planejamento, organização e gestão de múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Requisitos desejáveis (diferenciais)

  • Experiência em ambientes de varejo de grande porte;

  • Interface com áreas multidisciplinares e agências externas;

title: Sales Development Associate
description:
Job Description

This role is the commercial growth track for NDT Global’s/ TSC Subsea ILI and Subsea & Robotics business in South America. Reporting directly to the Country Manager and working alongside experienced Regional Sales Managers, the Sales Development Associate is responsible for identifying and developing new opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, and progressively building direct client relationships. The role carries regional revenue contribution targets and is based in the Rio de Janeiro office. It is designed as a structured pathway toward full sales ownership.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop a qualified opportunity pipeline, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records in the CRM (Salesforce or equivalent).
  • Identify and qualify new business opportunities across the ILI and subsea inspection market in South America.
  • Lead and coordinate the preparation of technical-commercial proposals and bid responses, ensuring alignment with client requirements and NDT Global standards.
  • Build and maintain direct relationships with existing and prospective clients, progressively taking ownership of key accounts.
  • Work alongside Regional Sales Managers to support deal progression, client engagement strategies, and market development initiatives.
  • Monitor market trends, track competitor activity, and contribute market intelligence to refine regional sales strategies.
  • Represent NDT Global at industry events, conferences, and client meetings, participating actively in commercial and technical discussions.
  • Develop a solid working knowledge of ILI, subsea, and robotics inspection technologies, applications, and value propositions.
  • Support the Country Manager with forecasting, pipeline reporting, and commercial planning activities.
  • Contribute to broader commercial initiatives as the role evolves and sales ownership expands.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, production engineering, business administration, or related fields. A postgraduate degree in business management or asset integrity is a plus. Equivalent commercial experience of 3+ years will also be considered.
  • Commercial experience: Previous exposure to proposal development, bid management, or B2B sales processes is strongly desirable.
  • CRM proficiency: Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent CRM platforms is an advantage.
  • Software: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Languages: Fluent Portuguese (native level), advanced English required. Spanish is a strong plus for broader regional coverage.
  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with oil & gas, pipeline integrity, or subsea inspection markets is highly desirable but not mandatory.

Skillset

  • Commercially driven, with genuine motivation to develop and close business.
  • Strong communicator — able to engage confidently with clients and adapt messaging to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Resilient and persistent, comfortable operating in long sales cycles and complex procurement environments.
  • Strategic thinker, capable of mapping the market and identifying where value can be created.
  • Self-starter with a high level of personal accountability and ownership.
  • Collaborative, able to work effectively within a structured sales team while also operating independently.
  • Curious and quick to learn, with an interest in inspection technology and the energy sector.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge NDT technologies that ensure the safety and reliability of critical offshore infrastructure.
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment with a focus on professional development and growth.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Further career development through additional company provided training.

title: Traffic Analyst
description:
Company Overview

If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!

Role Summary

As an Import & Export Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring compliance with logistics requirements for import and export operations across a multi-unit area within the region. Your role will include international procurement activities, manage end-to-end import and export processes, and implementing and executing logistics strategies tailored to each location. You will also be responsible for maintaining strategic relationships with key logistics suppliers, aiming to maximize Flowserve’s resources and ensure excellence in customer experience from order placement through final delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Execute and monitor import and export processes, ensuring compliance with Brazilian customs legislation and international regulations.
  • Plan, coordinate, and track international logistics operations, ensuring delivery timelines, cost control, and service quality.
  • Perform international purchasing activities, including supplier negotiation, cost analysis, and full acquisition cycle management.
  • Develop and implement logistics strategies aligned with the needs of multiple business units and different locations.
  • Monitor and optimize logistics flows, proposing continuous improvements to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain strategic relationships with logistics providers (carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers), ensuring a high level of service.
  • Follow up on customs clearance processes, ensuring proper HS/NCM classification, documentation accuracy, and regulatory compliance.
  • Manage special customs regimes (such as Drawback, RECOF, and Bonded Warehouse), ensuring correct application and control.
  • Track international shipments (ocean, air, road, and multimodal), ensuring visibility and risk mitigation.
  • Prepare and analyze management reports and logistics KPIs to support decision-making.
  • Work closely with internal departments (Tax, Sales, Production Planning, among others) to ensure process alignment and efficiency.
  • Ensure excellence in the customer experience from order entry through final delivery.
  • Identify and mitigate operational risks, proposing agile and effective solutions when deviations occur.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in international Trade, International Relations, Business Administration, Logistics, or related fields.
  • Advanced English proficiency for written and verbal communication with suppliers and global teams. Spanish is a plus.
  • Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in international logistics, import/export operations, and/or international procurement.
  • Strong knowledge of Incoterms 2020 and Brazilian customs regulations.
  • Experience with import and export processes, including HS/NCM classification, DUIMP, customs clearance, licenses, and special regimes such as Drawback, RECOF, and Bonded Warehouse.
  • Experience in international procurement, including supplier development, follow-up, freight negotiation, and total landed cost analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Knowledge of international freight modalities: ocean (FCL/LCL), air, international road transport, and multimodal logistics.
  • Strong analytical profile with the ability to interpret critical data and generate concise management reports.
  • Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage multiple priorities, and work under tight deadlines.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interface with suppliers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and internal teams such as Tax, Sales, and Production Planning.
  • Strong customer focus (internal and external) with a proactive and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Experience / Skills

  • Spanish proficiency is a plus.

Mesmo que não tenhamos uma vaga aberta neste momento, seu perfil poderá ser considerado para oportunidades futuras, de acordo com sua experiência, senioridade e os projetos da LiveMode. Aqui, cada movimento é uma jogada para a liderança e inovação no mercado — e queremos pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo.

Como Coordenador(a) de Programas , sua missão será ser responsável pelos programas ao vivo, liderando a construção criativa e a execução no estúdio, garantindo consistência de formato, ritmo e qualidade editorial em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta pressão.

  • Executar o programa ao vivo, conduzindo chamadas e comandos objetivos, controlando timing e priorizando o que vai ao ar, garantindo que cortes, transições, VTs, gráficos e entradas aconteçam no momento certo, com comunicação clara e cadência de show;

Requisitos necessários:

  • Experiência em conteúdo e/ou produção de programas ao vivo , com atuação em dinâmica, ritmo e timing, incluindo rotinas de switcher e externas;
  • Vivência prática em planejar e executar as atividades que compõem o roteiro operacional do ao vivo (blocos, tempos, transições, VTs, entradas/saídas e elementos gráficos), com capacidade de transformar pauta/ideia em plano executável;

Descrição da vaga

Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.

Nós somos responsáveis por uma infraestrutura gigantesca que atende aos principais produtos de vídeo da Globo, como o Globoplay, Premiere e os Canais Globo. Além disso, somos responsáveis pela transmissão ao vivo de grandes eventos - desde os campeonatos estaduais de futebol, a Copa do Mundo, Olimpíadas, Rock in Rio e até as câmeras ao vivo do Big Brother Brasil, que fica disponível 24x7 para todos os assinantes do Globoplay.

Desafios estratégicos

O mercado de mídia e entretenimento vive numa constante transformação, com variadas formas, comportamentos, plataformas e monetização do consumo de conteúdo. Múltiplas empresas de diferentes segmentos competem pela atenção e pelo bolso do consumidor e dos anunciantes. Essa constante transformação vem muito da própria evolução da tecnologia no mundo.

Nesse cenário, a Globo vem buscando diferentes segmentos de audiência, novos produtos, novas estratégias de distribuição, novas formas de operar e novos modelos de negócio.

Para suportar tanta transformação, precisamos entender os movimentos da indústria, o mercado cliente, a nossa estratégia de negócio, as tendências de tecnologia, nossas alavancas e nossos gaps.

Projetar novas capacidades de tecnologia, transformar algumas e, buscar inovação e parcerias, se faz absolutamente necessário.

Atuação de Arquitetura

A Arquitetura de Tecnologia da Globo busca profissionais que possam trabalhar na interseção entre estratégia de negócio, tecnologia e a execução.

A área tem a missão de desenhar e propor estratégias, arquiteturas e roadmaps de evolução tecnológica para diversos domínios de negócio e foundations de tecnologia da empresa.

Faz isso com uma abordagem focada nos principais desafios transformacionais da empresa, nos níveis estratégico e tático e de maneira muito colaborativa com outras áreas de tecnologia e do negócio.

A área se estrutura nos papéis de arquitetura corporativa, arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura de dados & IA.

Traga sua experiência em benchmarks da indústria, mapas de capacidades, arquiteturas de referência, análises de gaps e buy or build e na construção de visões de futuro e roadmaps de tecnologia.

O que a área te oferece de oportunidade

  • Vai conduzir trabalhos de grande visibilidade que influenciam decisões estratégicas de tecnologia
  • Você vai ter um conhecimento amplo da empresa e da indústria de mídia
  • Vai desenvolver um olhar transversal e estratégico entre as capacidades de negócio e tecnológicas de toda a empresa

Modelo de trabalho

Híbrido (RJ ou SP)

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de Infraestrutura e Telecom, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia tecnológica e de negócio da companhia;
  • Construir e manter modelos arquiteturais, mapas de capacidades, princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos para orientar decisões executivas e estruturantes de I&T;
  • Produzir desenhos arquiteturais de alto nível conectando domínios, plataformas e capacidades tecnológicas;
  • Atuar de forma crítica e consultiva junto às áreas técnicas, questionando soluções, identificando lacunas e propondo direcionamentos estruturantes;
  • Avaliar impactos arquiteturais de novas iniciativas, tecnologias e decisões estratégicas;
  • Incorporar o conceito de AI-First Architecture nas decisões e modelos arquiteturais, promovendo automação, inteligência operacional e uso estratégico de dados;
  • Comunicar e apresentar conceitos arquiteturais para públicos técnicos e executivos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa

  • Formação superior em carreiras de tecnologia, como engenharias, ciência da computação, etc;
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura, escrita e comunicação;
  • Experiência como arquiteto corporativo, arquiteto de domínio ou arquiteto de soluções;
  • Experiência em ambientes tecnológicos complexos, distribuídos, híbridos ou multicloud;
  • Conhecimento prático em Infraestrutura, Telecomunicações ou ambos, com capacidade de sustentar decisões arquiteturais nesses domínios;
  • Experiência na definição de arquiteturas e direcionamentos técnicos em contextos de transformação tecnológica ou organizacional;
  • Experiência em modelagem de capacidades (Capability Mapping) e construção de modelos arquiteturais;
  • Capacidade de definir princípios, padrões e roadmaps tecnológicos;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura on-premises, cloud ou ambientes híbridos;
  • Entendimento de resiliência, disponibilidade, escalabilidade, automação e observabilidade em plataformas tecnológicas;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes, conectividade e serviços de telecom;
  • Entendimento conceitual de IA e suas relações com infraestrutura e telecom.

Conhecimentos que te destacam

  • Experiência em ambientes multicloud ou arquiteturas híbridas complexas;
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código e automação de plataformas;
  • Vivência em telecom definidos por software (SDN / NFV);
  • Experiência em integração entre ambientes on-premises e cloud;
  • Conhecimento em uso de IA em operações de tecnologia (AIOps ou Enterprise AI Solutions Architecture);
  • Experiência anterior em arquitetura de soluções, engenharia ou operações, combinada com visão sistêmica;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Arquitetura, Tecnologia, Telecom, Cloud ou áreas afins.

title: Travel Consultant And Sales Manager
description:
About Us

Dehouche is a leading provider of luxury tailor‑made travel to South America, specialising in unforgettable journeys for a discerning clientele. From custom‑built wilderness camps to luxury city hotel buyouts and "money can't buy" experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional service and creating memories that last a lifetime.

The Opportunity

We're growing our Rio de Janeiro team and hiring for two positions:

  • Travel Consultant – a senior sales role focused on converting enquiries into bookings and building lasting client relationships.
  • Sales Manager – a senior consultant who also leads, develops, and drives the performance of our consultant team.

Both roles share the same DNA: a highly personalised, authentic approach to selling, and a natural talent for understanding and anticipating client needs. If you're motivated by clients thanking you for the trip of a lifetime, we want to hear from you.

Travel Consultant – What You’ll Do

  • Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings by crafting bespoke itineraries that genuinely excite clients.
  • Consult with clients to uncover their aspirations, budget, and motivations, and translate those into compelling proposals.
  • Pitch and close confidently, handling objections and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Build trusted, long‑term relationships that drive repeat business and referrals.
  • Negotiate rates and added value with suppliers to keep our product competitively priced without compromising quality.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on destination developments, new openings, and emerging experiences across the region.

Sales Manager – What You’ll Do

In addition to everything above, you'll:

  • Lead and develop our team of travel consultants, coaching on consultative selling, proposal craft, and closing.
  • Own the team's pipeline and forecast: track conversion, identify bottlenecks, and intervene early.
  • Set, review, and drive individual and team revenue targets.
  • Act as a senior point of escalation on complex or high‑value enquiries.
  • Partner with leadership on commercial strategy, pricing, and supplier negotiations.
  • Help recruit, onboard, and shape the next generation of our team.

What We’re Looking For (Both Roles)

You’re a seasoned travel sales professional with a strong track record of selling high‑value travel and consistently hitting, and exceeding, revenue targets. You know how to move a client from "interested" to "booked".

You’re a natural closer. Confident pitching, comfortable talking about price, and able to create urgency without ever feeling pushy.

You have your finger on the pulse of South America: what's new, what's exciting, what clients can't find anywhere else.

You’re commercially minded. You understand margin, negotiate well with suppliers, and price trips competitively while maintaining the level of luxury synonymous with our brand.

Your attention to detail is excellent. The trips you sell are executed flawlessly, and your written correspondence is consistently polished.

You’re a team player. You share ideas freely and build strong relationships with clients, guides, and colleagues alike.

Additionally for the Sales Manager

  • Demonstrable experience leading or mentoring a sales team, with examples of how you've lifted individual or team performance.
  • Comfortable with numbers: pipeline reporting, forecasting, and conversion analysis.
  • The judgement to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let your team run.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in travel sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Knowledge of South America as a destination is essential. Latin America and the Caribbean a plus.
  • Native‑level English. Portuguese, Spanish, or other languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced, target‑driven environment.
  • Resilient, self‑motivated, and genuinely passionate about travel.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Rio de Janeiro.

The External Relations Department drives DNDi’s visibility, influence, and financial sustainability.

Its Communications, Private Sector Fundraising & Partnerships, and Institutional & Public Fundraising teams ensure that DNDi is visible, supported by committed stakeholders, and successful in securing the resources needed to deliver on its mission.

DNDi established its Latin American office in Rio de Janeiro in 2004. Since then, DNDi Latin America has made extensive contributions to advancing R&D and access partnerships across the region’s diverse health ecosystems. Its work spanning neglected diseases such as Chagas disease, leishmaniasis, hepatitis C, and dengue plays a central role in delivering DNDi’s global strategy. The office also leads advocacy efforts and drives capacity‑building initiatives through multi‑country clinical research and drug discovery platforms.

The External Relations Officer supports DNDi’s fundraising efforts by carrying out prospect research, developing grant proposals, managing donor reporting, and supporting day‑to‑day grant management, including institutional, public and private funding. Working closely with the External Relations Manager (ERM) and the global External Relations team, the Officer plays an active role in helping secure and steward resources essential to DNDi’s mission.

Approximately 60% of the role is dedicated to Latin America , supporting institutional, public, and private sector fundraising activities in the region, and 40% to global priorities , including prospect research, donor engagement, acknowledgements, and cross‑team efficiency initiatives.

This position is suited for a professional with strong writing and analytical skills , a clear interest in fundraising and development cooperation , and a commitment to working in the non‑profit and public health sector .

General Responsibilities (for both LATAM and Global)

  • Support grant writing and proposal development, including drafting narrative sections, compiling supporting documentation, and coordinating internal inputs.
  • Contribute to donor reporting, ensuring clarity, consistency, and compliance with donor requirements.
  • Conduct prospect research and analysis of calls for proposals from institutional, public, and private donors.
  • Support grant and donor activities, including record‑keeping, tracking deadlines, and updating Salesforce and internal systems.
  • Provide administrative and coordination support to fundraising activities, including organizing meetings, preparing briefs and documentation, and following up on action points.

Latin America‑Specific Responsibilities (Minimum 60%)

  • Monitor, map, and analyze existing and emerging donor opportunities relevant to DNDi’s work in Latin America.
  • Support the preparation of regional funding proposals and concept notes.
  • Assist in the coordination and management of local fundraising consultants, as required.

Global‑Specific Responsibilities (up to 40%)

  • Ad hoc support to global fundraising initiatives.

Additional /Project‑Specific Responsibilities

  • Participate in internal and external regional and global meetings related to fundraising, partnerships, and external relations.
  • Liaise with internal departments (R&D, Communications, Regional Offices) to support fundraising‑related inputs and coordination.
  • External Relations Officer reports to External Relations Manager.
  • Contributing manager - Associate Director.
  • Works closely with DNDi staff across the Latin America Regional Office and with global External Relations, Communications, R&D and Operations teams.
  • Interacts with donors, funding agencies, and external partners, as well as consultants and service providers involved in fundraising activities.
  • Collaborators, counterparts, and service providers are mainly in the functional area in and outside DNDi to get information, guidance, and feedback or to enlist cooperation. The incumbent has an external role focusing on exchanges on information and work with suppliers or officer level staff of partners and donors.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience with a graduate degree, at least one year with a post‑graduate degree.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and matrix structure.
  • Experience of working in public and private sector is highly desirable.
  • Graduate or post graduate degree.

  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team.
  • Well organized and structured.
  • Very good analytical skills.
  • Ability to contribute to the project delivery under minimum supervision.
  • Ability to manage small projects if delegated by upper levels with supervision.
  • Ability to supervise an Intern or Apprentice.
  • Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is an asset.
  • Interest in the responsible use of digital tools and artificial intelligence to support fundraising and administrative work.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Suite.

DNDi is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive organisation. title: Test Engineer - Qualification
description:
Test Engineer

Would you feel engaged working in an applied engineering laboratory where flexible pipes take shape through real‑world testing, directly contributing to solutions for the oil & gas industry? Would you be interested in planning, designing, and executing tests while transforming data and results into knowledge that supports research, development, and qualification? Join our Engineering Testing team! We are a center of excellence in engineering, qualification, and research serving the oil & gas industry. Our team plans and conducts prototype testing for qualification purposes, while also leading strategic investigations and developing solutions to complex, multidisciplinary challenges across the oil & gas sector.

Partner with the best

The Test Engineer will work in an applied engineering laboratory serving the oil & gas industry, with a strong focus on research, development, and qualification of flexible pipes. This role is responsible for planning, designing, executing, and reporting small‑, medium‑, and large‑scale testing activities, ensuring technical rigor, regulatory compliance, and reliable results within a multidisciplinary and highly experimental environment.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, review, and maintain engineering test documentation, including test procedures, technical specifications, test plans, and final reports.
  • Plan, execute, and oversee qualification testing with a strong hands‑on approach, ensuring compliance with applicable standards such as API 17B, Petrobras I‑ETs, and other relevant standards.
  • Perform critical analysis of test data and results, translating experimental outcomes into clear, technically sound conclusions.
  • Contribute to the design, specification, and commissioning of test equipment and systems, including instrumentation, control, hydraulic, thermal, and pressure systems.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout the qualification process, supporting engineers and technicians during test planning, execution, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Define and implement testing strategies to meet technical requirements, project schedules, and contractual commitments.
  • Monitor and communicate project status, highlighting key technical, operational, and commercial developments to stakeholders.
  • Support procurement activities related to test materials, components, and accessories using internal company systems.
  • Prepare and deliver technical responses to customers regarding specifications, test methodologies, and test results.
  • Collaborate within multidisciplinary teams to develop and apply conventional and non‑conventional testing techniques at small, medium, and large scales.
  • Ensure compliance with company Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, actively promoting a strong safety culture and promptly identifying and reporting risks, incidents, or non‑conformities.

Fuel your passion

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, with a minimum of two years of professional experience in a relevant technical environment.
  • Working knowledge of a wide range of sensors, including LVDTs, pressure transducers, temperature sensors, inclinometers, accelerometers, and strain gauges.
  • Solid background in instrumentation and mechanical design involving valves, varying pressure and temperature conditions, different fluids, and diverse connection systems.
  • Experience with data acquisition systems and experimental data handling.
  • Proven experience in mechanical engineering projects, covering both technical and administrative aspects such as planning, cost control, methodologies, and technical analyses.
  • Familiarity with flexible piping systems, including handling and auxiliary equipment design, as well as installation methodologies, is considered an advantage.
  • Fluent English skills, proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, and ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
  • Experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks or Autodesk Inventor is preferred.
  • Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools, with Power BI and Python commonly used in the role.
  • Strong engineering foundation with advanced analytical thinking and the maturity to address complex, high‑level technical challenges.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to guide, influence, and collaborate effectively, demonstrating strong interpersonal and leadership capabilities.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone works differently and that individuals perform at their best in different ways. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • The laboratory is located in Rio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil.
  • The role follows a Monday to Friday schedule, from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
  • The role is primarily on‑site, aligned with laboratory operations, with the possibility of one remote working day weekly when possible.
  • Occasional travel is expected for the follow‑up of testing activities at contracted laboratories, as well as for meetings at client offices.

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

  • Participate in operational reviews and provide production accounting input to support operational decision making.
  • Act as the technical focal point for production control and hydrocarbon accounting matters within the organization.
  • Support regulatory audits, inspections, and data requests related to production and other fluids accounting.
  • Prepare, validate, and submit mandatory monthly and annual production reports to the Brazilian regulatory authority (ANP).
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of production accounting tools and data analytics platforms.

Experience

Knowledge

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus

Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM

Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience)

Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus

About Quectel

Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular IoT modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R&D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud.

This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now.

Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R&D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America.

Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here.

We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial IoT, connected payments, and more.

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands‑on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market.

Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions.
  • Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs.
  • Get hands‑on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues.
  • Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities.
  • Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster.
  • Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM.
  • Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer‑facing or FAE roles.
  • Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces.
  • Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis.
  • Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug.
  • Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes.
  • Hands‑on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS).
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points For

  • Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type‑C.
  • Experience with high‑speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO.
  • RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi‑Fi 802.11.
  • Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration.
  • Team leadership or technical mentoring experience.

The Tech You'll Work With

  • Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas.
  • Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies.
  • Founding‑team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it.
  • Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM.
  • Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000‑person publicly‑listed IoT company behind you.
  • Direct line to global R&D — work side‑by‑side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem.
  • Cutting‑edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices.
  • Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales.
  • Customer‑facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products.
  • Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader.
  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co‑pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows.

Ready to Apply?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

description:
A Nuuvem, uma líder na distribuição digital de jogos na América Latina, é conhecida por sua paixão profunda por jogos e uma forte presença no mercado. Estamos em busca de talentos para fazer parte da nossa guilda de pro players, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho.

Estamos à procura de uma pessoa Tech Leader, com experiência sólida em Ruby on Rails, para liderar tecnicamente um de nossos squads. Este é um papel híbrido: aproximadamente 50% do seu tempo será dedicado a atuar como desenvolvedor(a) sênior, escrevendo e revisando código, e os outros 50% à liderança e gestão do time — conduzindo 1:1s, acompanhando o desenvolvimento das pessoas, definindo prioridades técnicas e garantindo a saúde dos sistemas e processos.

Você se juntará a uma equipe de entusiastas da indústria de jogos e da web altamente qualificados, criando soluções em um ambiente ágil e apaixonado. O trabalho em equipe é essencial, além de ser um buscador de conhecimento e autossuficiente quando necessário.

Você precisa ser obcecado em produzir código de alta qualidade rapidamente, visualizando qualquer funcionalidade como parte do valor total da plataforma, sem perder o foco em entregar resultados. Segurança e desempenho devem ser suas prioridades principais. Ao mesmo tempo, você precisa se preocupar genuinamente com o crescimento e bem-estar das pessoas do seu time, sendo capaz de inspirar, orientar e desenvolver profissionais com autonomia e responsabilidade.

Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto. Iremos fornecer todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser! Você só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade.

Principais Responsabilidades:

No lado técnico (Developer):

  • Projetar, desenvolver e testar novos recursos para a plataforma, mantendo atuação técnica relevante e consistente.
  • Manter e melhorar a base de código atual, corrigindo rapidamente bugs e refatorando códigos problemáticos quando necessário.
  • Escrever código claro e organizado com base em separação de responsabilidades e na arquitetura do projeto, seguindo a semântica correta dos subdomínios do time.
  • Promover padrões, boas práticas, testes balanceados pela pirâmide de testes e revisões de código consistentes, elevando a qualidade coletiva.
  • Liderar pesquisas e experimentos ao lidar com requisitos novos e desafiadores.
  • Realizar trabalhos complexos como planejamento de capacidade, testes de carga e melhorias de segurança.

No lado de liderança e gestão (Tech Leader):

  • Conduzir 1:1s regulares, definir e acompanhar Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDIs), realizar avaliações de desempenho e apoiar o bem‑estar e equilíbrio de carga do time.
  • Estruturar e melhorar continuamente rituais do time: planejamento, dailies, reviews/demos e retrospectivas, garantindo cadência e previsibilidade.
  • Co‑definir o roadmap técnico com Produto, tomando decisões sobre trade-offs de escopo, custo e prazo, e garantindo alinhamento com objetivos da empresa.
  • Coordenar iniciativas de confiabilidade (observabilidade, performance, segurança) e conduzir manutenções de risco com planejamento e comunicação para impacto mínimo aos clientes.
  • Definir, medir e comunicar métricas do time (throughput, lead time, cycle time, qualidade, cobertura de testes, disponibilidade, débito técnico), usando‑as para decisões e coaching.
  • Liderar a resposta a incidentes dentro do escopo da equipe, coordenando pessoas, priorizando ações e garantindo comunicação clara com stakeholders.
  • Participar de recrutamento/seleção, onboarding e identificação de futuras lideranças.

Você tem o perfil que buscamos se…

  • Você tem proficiência e habilidades de comunicação em inglês verbal e escrito (não precisa ser fluente, mas precisa ser capaz de ler e escrever bem em inglês).
  • Você é apaixonado por tecnologia (e jogos!).
  • Você é um leitor voraz de livros.
  • Você é capaz de entender os requisitos de negócios e traduzi-los em definições técnicas.
  • Você faz perguntas poderosas - a partir disso, vamos (re)definir histórias de usuários, critérios de aceitação, especificações. Sempre questionando (sem perder o foco).
  • Você vê o quadro geral dos problemas e é obcecado com detalhes (relevantes).
  • Você toma decisões técnicas pensando no longo prazo, não apenas em “fazer funcionar agora”.
  • Você também é orientado por resultados/entrega e é um solucionador de problemas.
  • Você tem orgulho do código que escreve e se importa genuinamente com a saúde e evolução dele no futuro.
  • Você tem um saudável desrespeito pelo “impossível”.
  • Você se preocupa genuinamente com o crescimento das pessoas e entende que o sucesso do time é o seu sucesso.
  • Você sabe dar e receber feedbacks de forma respeitosa, direta e construtiva.
  • Você consegue discordar e se comprometer, equilibrando opiniões técnicas com decisões do grupo e da empresa.

Em que acreditamos…

  • Pair programming é sempre uma boa ideia.
  • Código sem boa cobertura de testes automatizado está incompleto (além de não ser profissional).
  • Todo que pode ser automatizado, deve ser automatizado.
  • Qualidade e quantidade estão em equilíbrio - estamos sempre em busca desse equilíbrio.
  • Um bom produto vem de uma ótima experiência e valor entregue.
  • Ouvir, muitas vezes, é mais importante do que falar. Mostrar é melhor do que contar.
  • O trabalho remoto deve ser predominantemente assíncrono, deixando os momentos síncronos para quando são realmente melhor aproveitados.
  • Documentação clara, extensa (porém concisa) e atualizada vale ouro, e é um dos segredos do nosso sucesso.

Importante

não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um "checklist" de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

A modalidade para essa posição é PJ, com faixa salarial aproximada de R$11.600 a R$13.100.

Power Ups

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto: Cuidar da saúde não é brincadeira. Aqui você usufrui de um plano top de linha da AMIL com um desconto de apenas R$1 ao colaborador (Conforme regras da ANS, é necessário vínculo ativo com a Receita Federal há pelo menos 180 dias para MEI, ME ou EIRELI e 60 dias para LTDA para inclusão no plano.)
  • Ausência remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir a família, jogar a qualquer hora, etc.
  • Ajuda de Custo Mensal: Todo apoio é bem‑vindo! Mensalmente oferecemos R$500,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios (categoria saldo livre) para nosso time estruturar seu ambiente de trabalho, uma internet de qualidade, home office e auxiliar nas contas de casa.
  • Crescimento Pessoal: Não queremos que você pare de aprender nunca! Por isso, todo colaborador tem o saldo de $70 dólares (aproximadamente R$345,00) por semestre para investir em seu crescimento profissional, seja em forma de curso, livro, workshop, eventos, etc.
  • 4 Days Off 4you: aqui na Nuuvem todo mundo ganha 4 dias de folga por ano para tirar quando você quiser.
  • Carrinho de Jogo do Mês: Se eu te contar que todo mês você pode escolher quantos itens quiser da nossa loja, até atingir o valor total de R$360,00, você acredita? É isso mesmo, jogos totalmente grátis, do seu jeito e sem burocracia. Escolheu, jogou!
  • Cupom de 20%: Aí que a gente vê quem é amigo! Além do item do mês você ainda tem direito a 10 cupons de 20% na nossa loja anualmente para usar com você mesmo ou para dar de presente para amigos e familiares. A biblioteca de jogos agradece!
  • Open English: Quem nunca jogou um game em inglês, não é mesmo? Temos uma parceria super legal com a Open English para aprimorar o seu inglês e/ou espanhol!
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass): Ficar sentado no computador o dia todo não dá, né? Oferecemos acesso ao App Wellhub que tem convênio com diversas academia, estúdios e também inclui terapia, nutrição e treinos online.
  • AVUS: Porque saúde é prioridade para a Nuuvem! Com essa plataforma de benefícios, nosso time tem acesso a assistência virtual de alta qualidade e uma rede de profissionais em todo o Brasil, garantindo cuidados médicos personalizados a qualquer hora e lugar.
  • Starbem: Porque saúde mental é importante para nós! Aqui você tem acesso ao app Starbem com consultas médicas, psicológicas e nutricionais, além de descontos em farmácias sem custos adicionais!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real‑world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.

What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent‑like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool‑using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.

What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree‑based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit‑learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML‑related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding‑based retrieval .

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI‑native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end‑to‑end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
We’re looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.

If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you’re allergic to bloated, brittle WordPress builds, you’ll fit right in.

Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.

API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).

Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server‑side events where needed).
  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel‑faithful, on‑brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.

Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Hands‑on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and server‑less functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.

Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server‑side tracking).

Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E‑commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.

Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You’d rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail‑oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non‑technical teammates; you can explain trade‑offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast‑moving agency environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60-90 days, you will:
    • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end‑to‑end.
    • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
    • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
    • Become the internal go‑to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Director, Center for Career Excellence
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are seeking a Director of the Center for Career Excellence (CCE) that provides visionary and strategic leadership for the center. They serve as the liaison between the Office of the Dean and various departments within the School of Business, corporate partners, faculty, and students. In this role, the Director will develop the Center's strategic vision, including overseeing the implementation of career-readiness events for students, establishing and cultivating partnerships with corporations to enable successful recruitment activities that build relationships with students seeking opportunities. The Director is also responsible for creating center goals, timelines, processes, and performing other strategic duties that contribute to the Center's success. Additionally, the Director will gather quantitative data and statistical evidence to evaluate the Center for Career Excellence's effectiveness. This includes tracking student success and suggesting ways to improve and sustain the Center’s ongoing success.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises CCE staff, including but not limited to coordinators, and student employees. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of the Center employees. Responsible for performing some non-supervisory duties in addition to supervisory responsibilities.

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Assistant Dean of Impact and Engagement at the School of Business, the Director is responsible for the management and implementation of a school-wide career development program that is aligned with institutional goals and the strategic plan. The Director maintains and cultivates relationships with internal and external contacts, including deans, university faculty, staff, students, potential employers, corporations, organizations, and agencies. Up to two days per week, telework may be offered during non-peak periods.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Creates, manages, and executes the Center's strategic plan.
  • Leads the implementation of a comprehensive, school-wide career development program, to include career coaching, career development, employer relations, and recruitment.
  • Develops a high-quality employer relations program that will attract corporate partners committed to providing career opportunities for School of Business students.
  • Oversees the execution of career development events, including career fairs, workshops, and student sessions.
  • Effectively manages the CCE calendar that promotes employer/student engagement.
  • Performs specialized administrative and academic functions, including research and analyses, program coordination and monitoring, data collection, counseling, surveys, reports, and recommend program changes.
  • Prepares reports, financial statements, and records of program activities, progress, and status, as well as related special reports, for the director.
  • Ensures that the goals and objectives specified for the center are accomplished in accordance with priorities, time, and funding limitations, as well as any other specifications.
  • Develops collaborative relationships with deans, faculty, and other professionals across the University to support career development initiatives.
  • Identifies and pursues sponsorships and other external funding opportunities that support career-related goals and objectives.
  • Develops, maintains, and grows professional relationships with corporate, government, and nonprofit representatives to support career development and placement of School of Business students.
  • Collaborate with campus partners to address barriers to participation and equitable placement.
  • Establishes outcome benchmarks and performance indicators aligned with institutional and accreditation expectations.
  • Collects, analyzes, and communicates data on student engagement, career outcomes, and post-graduate success.
  • Serves as an institutional resource for identifying high-impact practices in career development by actively participating in professional organizations and presenting at professional conferences.
  • Manages operating budget (generated and allocated) and day-to-day financial activities, including purchasing and vendor negotiations.
  • Develops annual and impact reports.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

This role operates under a Hybrid work arrangement with a mandatory minimum of three on-campus workdays each week. Telework for up to two days per week may be permitted with supervisory recommendation and approval from the Office of the Dean, and the designation may be subject to change during the summer session as indicated by the Office of the Dean or the University.

Core Competencies

  • Comprehensive understanding of and commitment to the goals and responsibilities of centralized and decentralized career development offerings within university settings.
  • Thorough understanding of the benefits of workplace diversity and the career-related developmental needs of Black, first- generation, and underrepresented populations.
  • Knowledge of high-impact face-to-face career-related programming.
  • Experienced data-informed decision-maker.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and managing organizational change.
  • Effective organizational and management skills.
  • Demonstrated public relations and marketing competencies that will enhance the University’s career development programming.
  • Knowledge of administrative and supervisory principles and practices.
  • Maintains a professional and welcoming work environment, is a team player, and is an independent thinker.
  • Superior oral and written communication skills, superior organization skills, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to problem-solve and make decisions promptly.
  • The ability to work effectively with people from a variety of culturally diverse backgrounds.

Minimum Requirements

  • Master’s degree in administration, business, organizational leadership, or related area (terminal degree preferred).
  • A minimum of seven to ten years of progressive leadership experience in career services, workforce development, a corporate or university setting.
  • Skilled in planning work, able to analyze, retain knowledge, show initiative, and be resourceful in finding information pertaining to the job.
  • Experience with career outcomes tracking and career management technologies.
  • Proven leadership skills in managing teams that serve internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong technical skills required (Data analytic tools, Microsoft Office Suite, Office 365 Applications, Suite, spreadsheets and formulas, Google Drive, Adobe Professional, etc.).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and sponsors.
  • Ability to multitask efficiently.

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not to be construed as a contract for employment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $90,000 - $95,000
