description:
O Fonoaudiólogo (a) é responsável por realizar avaliações, diagnósticos e intervenções em pacientes com distúrbios de comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, atuando sob supervisão e contribuindo para a promoção da saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes. Atua em ambientes clínicos, aplicando técnicas específicas e acompanhando a evolução dos tratamentos. Sua atuação envolve também a orientação de pacientes e familiares, além de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para oferecer um atendimento integral e de qualidade, promovendo a reabilitação e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos atendidos.

  • Realizar avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando instrumentos e protocolos específicos para identificar alterações na comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, garantindo precisão nos diagnósticos iniciais.
  • Aplicar técnicas de intervenção e reabilitação fonoaudiológica de acordo com o diagnóstico, adaptando estratégias às necessidades individuais de cada paciente, incluindo exercícios, orientações e uso de recursos auxiliares quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes durante o tratamento, ajustando as intervenções conforme a resposta ao tratamento e documentando todas as atividades realizadas de forma detalhada e organizada.
  • Prestar orientações a pacientes, familiares e equipes de saúde sobre estratégias de comunicação, cuidados com a audição, higiene vocal e prevenção de distúrbios, promovendo a conscientização e o autocuidado.
  • Participar de reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo com informações clínicas relevantes para o planejamento e execução do tratamento, além de colaborar na elaboração de planos de cuidado integrados.
  • Realizar atividades de educação em saúde, promovendo ações de conscientização sobre a importância da saúde auditiva, vocal e de comunicação na comunidade e nos ambientes de trabalho.
  • Manter registros atualizados de prontuários, relatórios e demais documentos clínicos, garantindo a confidencialidade e o cumprimento das normas éticas e legais da profissão.
  • Participar de treinamentos, cursos e atualizações profissionais para aprimorar conhecimentos técnicos e metodológicos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados.
  • Auxiliar na organização e manutenção do espaço clínico, garantindo condições adequadas para a realização dos atendimentos e o bem-estar dos pacientes.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de saúde na implementação de programas de prevenção, triagem e promoção da saúde auditiva e da comunicação, atuando de forma proativa na comunidade.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain scheduling and tracking systems for long-acting injectable HIV medications.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff and specialty pharmacies to ensure timely medication procurement and dosing.
  • Monitor injection schedules and proactively address potential delays or barriers to care.
  • Assist with patient reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up outreach to reduce missed visits.
  • Perform patient check-in and check-out procedures.
  • Verify insurance eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient interactions and care coordination activities in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
  • Support reporting initiatives related to patient engagement and viral suppression outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, nurses, case managers, and pharmacy partners.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred). Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$19.23 Hourly

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. About The Role

We partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting‑edge AI models.   • Review, analyze, and evaluate security policies, controls, and procedures for accuracy and completeness

  • Detail‑oriented with strong written reasoning and communication skills
  • Self‑motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation, data quality review, or AI evaluation workflows
  • Relevant certifications such as CISA, CRISC, CISSP, or CISM
  • Background in information security, internal audit, or enterprise risk management

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems alongside top research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and workload
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global community of experts
  • Contribute to meaningful work that advances AI understanding of real‑world security and compliance
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world.   • Proficiency in Excel and SQL
  • Intellectual curiosity

It’s Great if you Have:

  • Exposure to one or more data analysis packages or databases, e.g., SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL
  • Experience in digital marketing

title: MÉDICO ENDOSCOPISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental referente as patologias do sistema digestivo
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, etc
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa)
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Reporting to the VP of ORC, the role acts as Equinor’s primary interface with regulators and industry bodies, embedding regulatory requirements into both governance systems and daily operations. The position operates in a highly complex environment, requiring oversight of diverse and evolving regulatory regimes, enterprise-wide alignment across multiple business areas (projects, operations, drilling, and corporate functions), and integration of technical standards into actionable compliance practices. It carries end-to-end lifecycle accountability and must manage dynamic external pressures, including regulatory changes and stakeholder expectations. The mandate includes defining regulatory strategy and governance for Brazil, ensuring compliance across all assets and projects, influencing assurance plans and audits, and establishing organizational competence and performance standards. It also holds authority in regulatory engagement and decision-making related to compliance pathways. Risk management is central: the role mitigates enterprise-critical risks such as shutdowns, penalties, and reputational damage by proactively identifying compliance gaps, leading audits and inspections, and embedding systemic improvements into management systems. Commercially, the role protects production continuity, project timelines, and cost efficiency by preventing regulatory disruptions and enabling smoother approvals. It also strengthens relationships with authorities, enhancing strategic positioning.Within this position, your key tasks will be to:* Coordinate and manage communications with regulatory authorities, ensuring timely and accurate responses.* Organize meetings, inspections, workshops, and engagement sessions with authorities and internal stakeholders.* Support operational and project teams with regulatory guidance and clarification on authority requirements.* Monitor validity and renewal of operational licenses, permits, and authorizations.* Track and follow up regulatory obligations, submissions, reports, and authority deadlines.* Coordinate and support internal regulatory verifications, external audits, and offshore inspections.* Maintain updated records and documentation in internal compliance and management systems.* Monitor regulatory updates, industry developments, and public consultations, communicating impacts to the organization.* Support preparation of action plans, closure evidence verification, and continuous improvement initiatives related to regulatory compliance and authority engagement.# Here's what we expect from you:At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:* Between 8+ years of experience working with Risk Management and Regulatory Compliance;* Extensive experience managing regulatory compliance and authority engagement within the oil & gas, maritime, energy, or other highly regulated industrial sectors.* Proven experience interfacing with Brazilian regulatory authorities, particularly ANP, maritime authorities, and labor authorities.* Strong knowledge of Brazilian operational regulatory frameworks applicable to offshore operations, drilling, production, marine activities, and project execution.* Experience coordinating regulatory audits, inspections, verifications, and authority visits, including preparation of documentation, action plans, and closure follow-up.* Demonstrated experience managing licenses, permits, regulatory submissions, notifications, and administrative processes with authorities.* Experience supporting incident reporting processes, regulatory investigations, and preparation of responses or administrative defenses related to notices of non-compliance.* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capability, with the ability to establish credibility and trust with authorities and internal leadership.* Excellent communication and coordination skills, capable of managing multiple interfaces and operating effectively under pressure.* Proactive, organized, and solution-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail and continuous improvement focus.We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer:Not just a job - a careerIn Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.Attractive rewardsWe give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.Wellness and work-life balanceWe care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.An inclusive cultureWe believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.# Equal opportunities for everyoneEquinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We also believe everyone should be paid fairly and consistently for their contribution to our collective success. To ensure fairness and transparency, positions at Equinor are evaluated using our global job architecture based on the position’s responsibilities, complexity, and impact, and regularly reviewed to ensure consistency and alignment across the organisation.# Important notes about the application processWe expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process.   • Gestão de Ativos (ITAM): Garantir a integridade do inventário de hardware e software, monitorando o ciclo de vida dos ativos e a conformidade de licenciamento (Compliance).

  • Experiência em Governança de TI, Gestão de Serviços ou Compliance.
  • Experiência em frameworks de mercado como ITIL.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de mapeamento de processos (BPMN).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de Segurança da Informação (ISO 27001) e LGPD.
  • Visão técnica sobre administração de diretórios e ferramentas de inventário.

Faça parte de uma empresa referência no mercado de fundos estruturados e desenvolva sua carreira em um ambiente técnico, dinâmico e altamente regulado.

Como Analista Contábil Jr, você terá a oportunidade de atuar diretamente com diferentes tipos de fundos de investimento (FII, FIP, FIAGRO e fundos regulados pela ICVM 555), participando de rotinas contábeis essenciais e contribuindo para a qualidade das informações reportadas ao mercado.

Essa é uma excelente oportunidade para quem busca crescimento na área de contabilidade de fundos, com exposição a demandas regulatórias, auditorias e processos que exigem alto nível de organização, precisão e responsabilidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Contato direto com diferentes estruturas de fundos de investimento;
  • Ambiente com alto nível de governança e rigor técnico;
  • Proximidade com auditorias e exigências regulatórias (CVM);
  • Time colaborativo, com troca constante de conhecimento;
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e evolução na carreira.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar conciliações contábeis de baixa e média complexidade, com foco no fechamento mensal e apuração de resultados;
  • Atuar na contabilização de operações de fundos de investimento (aplicações, resgates, marcação a mercado, provisões, receitas, despesas e eventos societários);
  • Elaborar a escrituração contábil de fundos, garantindo conformidade com normas da CVM e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de demonstrações financeiras, balancetes e relatórios regulatórios;
  • Realizar a exportação e análise de obrigações acessórias, assegurando conformidade fiscal;
  • Prestar suporte a auditorias internas e externas;
  • Apoiar na análise de regulamentos, lâminas e documentos societários.

O que buscamos:

Buscamos um profissional com perfil analítico, organizado e atento a detalhes, que tenha comprometimento com prazos e qualidade das entregas. Esperamos alguém que se adapte bem a rotinas estruturadas, mas que também tenha curiosidade para entender o negócio e contribuir com melhorias.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis;
  • CRC ativo;
  • Conhecimento Excel em nível avançado.

Diferenciais que vão te destacar:

  • Experiência prévia com fundos de investimento;
  • Conhecimento em fundos estruturados (FII, FIP, FIAGRO);
  • Certificação CPA-20.

Informações adicionais

Local:

Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, RJ (100% presencial)

Horário:

De segunda à sexta-feira, de 9 às 18 horas

Benefícios:

  • Clube de Parcerias: Descontos exclusivos em academias (Wellhub e Totalpass), farmácias, restaurantes, cursos de idiomas e muito mais para você aproveitar ao máximo!

title: Senior QA Analyst (Remote)
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is looking for a Senior QA Analyst to manage the daily QA activity related to work submitted by the Engineering Team. The Senior QA Analyst will be responsible for testing products to ensure that the software runs smoothly and meets client needs both in functionality and scale.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and manage processes to ensure that products meet required specifications for quality, function, and reliability prior to delivery.
  • Communicate quality standards and parameters to QA team and development team.
  • Coordinate product testing processes.
  • Identify and analyze issues, bugs, defects, and other problems, particularly when problems recur in multiple products; recommend and facilitate solutions to these issues.
  • Review client, customer, and user feedback.
  • Work with manager to help communicate releases to the business.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent and/or related work experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant QA/testing automation experience.
  • Experience with business software systems and user management.
  • Knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes.
  • Teamwork oriented.
  • Exceptional ability to multi‑task and balance multiple projects and priorities.
  • Ingenuity and willingness to learn new techniques.
  • Superior problem‑solving ability; an analytical mindset.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills – both verbal and written.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted testing tools and workflows, including leveraging LLMs to generate test cases, analyze logs, and identify edge cases.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, and Cypress for end‑to‑end browser‑based testing.
  • Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or comparable frameworks for validating service‑layer behavior.
  • Familiarity with AI‑powered QA platforms such as Testim, Mabl, or Functionize that use ML to create and maintain automated tests.
  • Understanding of CI/CD integration for automated test pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
  • Ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools that improve test coverage, reduce manual effort, and shorten feedback cycles.
  • Comfort working alongside AI‑generated code and validating its correctness through structured test strategies.
  • Awareness of responsible AI usage in testing, including prompt engineering basics and understanding model limitations.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

title: Indirect Procurement Specialist - Capex
description:
Indirect Procurement Specialist - CAPEX

Lubrizol Corporation – Rio de Janeiro, Salary: BRL 150,000 – 200,000

Shape the Future with Us.

At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion.

As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact – on your career, your community, and the world around you.

Position Summary

The Indirect Procurement Specialist – CAPEX will be responsible for managing capital expenditure procurement with a strong focus on engineering and turnkey projects. Reporting directly to the Head of Procurement LATAM, this role plays a key part in delivering cost‑effective, compliant, and timely sourcing aligned with Lubrizol’s strategic objectives.

The position requires close collaboration with Engineering, Operations, and Project Management teams, strong engagement with key suppliers, and consistent delivery of value through negotiation, supplier relationship management, and project execution support. This is a hybrid position, based out of either our São Paulo office (Parque da Cidade) or the Rio de Janeiro office (Centro – Av. Rio Branco).

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies with a primary focus on CAPEX and engineering‑related categories (turnkey and construction services, infrastructure, utilities, and equipment).
  • Act as the main procurement interface for engineering and project management functions, ensuring alignment of technical requirements, project timelines, and cost objectives.
  • Lead negotiations and contract management activities through SirionCLM, ensuring compliance with company policies and local regulations.
  • Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and cost drivers related to engineering and capital projects to identify opportunities for cost optimization, innovation, and risk mitigation.
  • Partner with key stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Engineering, HR, and Legal to support regional procurement initiatives.
  • Contribute to procurement KPIs, reporting, and continuous improvement efforts across indirect spend.
  • Support strategic sourcing alignment across LATAM, ensuring process consistency and value creation.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • Minimum of 7 years of procurement experience, including proven expertise in CAPEX procurement and engineering projects.
  • Solid understanding of EPC, EPCM, and turnkey contract structures, and supplier qualification for engineering projects.
  • Experience managing complex sourcing projects in multinational or matrixed environments.
  • Knowledge of local tax regulations and BPO (Business Process Outsourcing) environments is a plus.
  • Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ownership, strategic mindset, and customer focus.

title: Vendedor Externo (Ekotruck)
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Assessorar a gestão da Unidade na ausência deste, realizando interface com Gestor e demais equipes, acompanhando o processo de trabalho e direcionamento de fluxo, assim como mantendo a Gestão informada de toda e qualquer situação de não conformidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Disponibilidade total para atuação em escala de cobertura.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering within fast‑paced, cloud‑native environments

  • Experience building and managing scalable ETL pipelines and data lake infrastructure

  • Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills to support BI, analytics, and engineering teams

5+ years of data engineering experience in an AWS-based environment where data powers decision‑making across product, marketing, and operations.

YOUR ROLE

Lead scalable data engineering efforts that empower cross‑functional teams with reliable, timely, and actionable data, ensuring Launch Potato’s analytics and business intelligence infrastructure fuels strategic growth.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and optimize scalable, efficient ETL and data lake processes that proactively catch issues before they impact the business

  • Serve as the internal point of contact for reporting infrastructure—delivering ad hoc data analyses and driving consistent data integrity
  • Drive adoption and advancement of Looker dashboards by ensuring robust and scalable backend data support
  • Contribute to the future of Launch Potato’s data team by mentoring peers and shaping a high‑performance, quality‑first engineering culture

COMPETENCIES

  • Data Engineering Mastery: Demonstrates technical excellence in building data pipelines, troubleshooting distributed systems, and scaling infrastructure using AWS and open‑source tools
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Communicates clearly across technical and non‑technical teams, translating business needs into robust data solutions
  • Proactive Ownership: Operates with a strong sense of accountability; identifies and solves data issues independently and efficiently
  • Quality‑Driven Execution: Holds a high bar for data accuracy, auditability, and documentation throughout all systems and workflows
  • Strategic Thinking: Anticipates how data infrastructure impacts wider company OKRs and proactively suggests improvements and innovations
  • Growth Mindset: Seeks out opportunities to elevate team capabilities, mentor others, and stay ahead of evolving best practices in data engineering

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Analyst
description:
Would you like to be part of a growing organisation in the maritime and energy industry? At Navvik, we are building a dynamic and collaborative environment, and we are looking for a professional to join our Accounts Payable & Receivable team in Rio de Janeiro.

In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the company’s financial operations, working closely with different areas and stakeholders. You will contribute to the efficiency and reliability of our processes, ensuring accuracy, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high-quality financial execution.

Responsabilities

You will support core financial activities, with a focus on accounts payable and receivable processes, ensuring structure, organisation, and smooth day-to-day operations.

In your daily work, you will be responsible for processing and reviewing supplier invoices, ensuring compliance with internal policies and procedures. You will also monitor the accounts payable flow, ensuring timely payments while contributing to effective cash flow management.

You will interact with suppliers, supporting the resolution of payment-related queries and performing reconciliations to ensure accuracy and consistency in financial records.

Additionally, you will support accounts receivable activities, including invoice issuance, tracking incoming payments, and engaging with customers when needed. You will help monitor outstanding balances and support collection efforts.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes and internal controls, working closely with the finance team and other departments to enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.

Requirements

We are looking for a professional with an analytical mindset, strong organisational skills, and attention to detail, who is motivated to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment and contribute to the efficiency of financial operations.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to:

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • Have prior experience in Accounts Payable (required) and ideally exposure to Accounts Receivable
  • Demonstrate knowledge of financial processes such as invoice-to-pay, reconciliations, and internal controls
  • Have experience with financial systems/ERPs (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite or similar)
  • Possess intermediate to advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis)
  • Have advanced English and Portuguese proficiency (written and spoken)
  • Show strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Demonstrate good communication skills and the ability to interact with different stakeholders

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the process will be closed once we find the right candidate. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Manager, Stadium Entertainment
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Events & Entertainment, Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Stadium Entertainment Manager will be responsible for the planning, coordination and delivery of all in‑stadium entertainment activations across all assigned venues of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™. Reporting to the Head of Entertainment and supporting the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, this role ensures that all entertainment elements — including pre‑match programming, music, audio‑visual content, half‑time activations, and fan engagement moments — are delivered to the highest standard. The role supports and coordinates the implementation of the Stadium Entertainment operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Stadium Entertainment Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with venue teams, technical suppliers, and the broader Entertainment department, the Stadium Entertainment Manager will act as the primary entertainment point of contact for their assigned venue(s), managing operational workflows, coordinating suppliers, and overseeing delivery timelines from a central coordination function. This role works in close collaboration with the on‑site venue entertainment teams, providing the planning structure, content, and operational direction required for seamless execution on match days.

The Stadium Entertainment Manager is an office‑based coordination role suited to an experienced live events professional with strong project management skills, who can drive high‑quality entertainment delivery across multiple venues through effective planning, clear communication, and proactive stakeholder management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Stadium Entertainment Delivery

  • Manage the day‑to‑day planning and delivery of all entertainment activations at assigned venue(s).
  • Execute the FIFA‑approved Entertainment Concept at venue level, maintaining quality and consistency throughout the tournament.
  • Coordinate all entertainment elements on match days, including pre‑match shows, half‑time activations, music programming and AV content.
  • Act as the primary on‑site entertainment point of contact for venue management, technical crews, and Functional Area partners.

Team Support

  • Support the Stadium Entertainment Team by contributing to day‑to‑day coordination, operational readiness, and delivery standards across all entertainment activities.
  • Assist with the onboarding and support of Stadium Entertainment personnel—including full‑time staff, freelancers, and event‑time workforce—helping ensure consistent standards and operational preparedness.
  • Contribute to internal talent development through daily guidance, structured feedback, and knowledge sharing within the entertainment workstream.
  • Support effective collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units involved in stadium entertainment delivery.
  • Contribute to coordination between venue‑based entertainment teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution across all stadiums.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Ceremonies Team to ensure unified delivery across entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Technical & Production Coordination

  • Liaise with technical suppliers including AV, LED, sound, and lighting providers to ensure correct installation and operation of all entertainment infrastructure.
  • Support pre‑event technical surveys, production walkthroughs, and infrastructure assessments at assigned venues.
  • Coordinate rehearsals and technical run‑throughs, ensuring all entertainment elements are tested and validated before match day.
  • Manage show rundowns, cue sheets, and entertainment schedules for each match at assigned venue(s).

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Support the preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), stadium production schedules, and PMC rundowns for Stadium Entertainment.
  • Assist in production processes, including coordinating technical surveys, gathering stadium LED screen specs, AV infrastructure reviews, and supplier installation planning.
  • Contribute to readiness activities and provide on‑site support during live operations to ensure delivery standards are met.
  • Support problem solving during matchday entertainment, escalating issues to the Senior Manager as needed.
  • Coordinate rehearsal planning, scheduling, documentation, and stakeholder communication in alignment with Senior Manager guidance.
  • Support the validation of entertainment elements during pre‑event testing and rehearsal phases.
  • Assist with venue‑level pre‑production tasks, including gathering technical information, supporting infrastructure assessments, and coordinating installation planning.

Content Production & Management

  • Coordinate the receipt, testing, and deployment of all entertainment content at venue level, including music, video, graphics, and scripts.
  • Ensure that all content is approved, correctly formatted, and delivered on time in line with operational deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate records of content usage and ensure IP/copyright compliance at venue level.

Planning, Scheduling & Documentation

  • Prepare match‑day reports, schedules, show notes and post‑event summaries for the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date operational documentation including rundowns, contact lists, and venue entertainment plans.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, briefings, and review sessions.
  • Flag operational risks and elevate issues to the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager in a timely manner.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Support procurement processes as directed by the Stadium Entertainment Senior Manager, including supplier briefing and evaluation.
  • Manage day‑to‑day relationships with entertainment suppliers and contractors at assigned venue(s).
  • Assist with budget management tasks, including forecasting inputs, cost‑tracking, variation documentation, and invoice processing, ensuring accuracy and timely follow‑up.
  • Help monitor contractual deliverables and timelines, ensuring they remain aligned with pre‑production schedules and operational readiness requirements, and escalating risks to the Senior Manager as needed.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Broadcast, Protocol, Safety, and other Functional Areas and stakeholders to integrate entertainment seamlessly into match‑day operations.
  • Support early‑phase cross‑functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by line management aligned with project delivery.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment and Senior Stadium Entertainment Manager in planning, operational readiness, and tournament‑wide entertainment integration.
  • Support cross‑venue entertainment activities and cover other venues as required during the tournament.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 5+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large‑scale public events.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering in‑venue or stadium entertainment programmes, including AV, music and audience engagement activations.
  • Experience working within large‑scale multi‑venue events or major international sporting events is highly desirable.
  • Track record of coordinating multiple suppliers and technical teams in high‑pressure, time‑critical environments.
  • Experience working with broadcast operations and an understanding of live TV production constraints is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Administrative skills: Ability to manage office and production documentation including RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high‑pressure environments.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • Communication skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • Organizational skills: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Problem‑solving skills: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.
  • Cross‑functional collaboration: Proven ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and diverse functional areas, ensuring alignment and contributing to the successful achievement of delivery goals.
  • Interpersonal skills: Builds effective working relationships across internal and cross‑functional teams, applying strong interpersonal skills to support smooth coordination and operational alignment.
  • Cultural sensitivity: Deep awareness and respect for diverse cultures; committed to ensuring ceremonies are inclusive, authentic, and globally resonant.
  • Passion for entertainment: Genuine passion for live performance, ceremony production, and the power of sport to inspire.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning/collaboration tools.
  • Experience of Monday.com an advantage.
  • Knowledge of and previous event / tournament experience across the stadiums in Brazil a plus.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Assistant Professor
description:
Position Overview

The Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science in the College of Engineering and Architecture at Howard University invites applications for a full‑time, tenure‑track position for a broadly trained computer scientist with research expertise and teaching interests in advancing artificial intelligence to address healthcare challenges with a focus on multimodal foundation models to clinical decision support systems. The anticipated start date is August 2026, and the position is part of the Office of the Provost Artificial Intelligence (AI) Cluster Hire Initiative, which aims to expand AI interdisciplinary research and instruction across the university.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct cutting‑edge, interdisciplinary research in AI with a focus on health applications.
  • Develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses in AI, machine learning, data science, or health informatics.
  • Collaborate across disciplines to apply AI methodologies to analyze and model complex healthcare data, including EMRs.
  • Pursue external funding to support research and training initiatives.
  • Mentor students from diverse backgrounds, fostering an inclusive and equitable academic environment.

Qualifications

  • A Ph.D. or equivalent terminal degree in a relevant field, such as computer science or data science.
  • Demonstrated ability or potential to secure external funding for research.
  • Experience or potential for excellence in teaching at the undergraduate and graduate levels.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research environments.
  • Demonstrated expertise in AI, machine learning, or multimodal modeling.
  • A record of (or potential for) impactful research, evidenced by publications, grants, or industry partnerships.
  • Experience or interest in applying AI to EMR data or healthcare challenges.
  • A commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration and promoting student access to and engagement in their teaching and research/scholarship/creative activities.

Salary Range

$100,000 – $115,000

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support.
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements.
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match.
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths.
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

title: Analista de Operações e Monitoramento do Sistema Integrado de Gestão (SAP)
description:
The Role

Como Administrador de Sistemas na Kyndryl, você resolverá problemas complexos e identificará possíveis questões futuras em uma ampla gama de plataformas e serviços. Você estará na linha de frente da nova tecnologia e da modernização, trabalhando com alguns dos nossos maiores clientes – o que significa alguns dos maiores do mundo.

Não existe um dia típico como Administrador de Sistemas na Kyndryl, porque nenhum projeto é igual ao outro. Você gerenciará dados de sistemas para clientes e fornecerá soluções diárias e conformidade com requisitos de segurança. Você supervisionará uma fila de tarefas e trabalhará diretamente com técnicos, priorizando chamados para entregar as melhores soluções aos nossos clientes.

Um dos benefícios de trabalhar na Kyndryl é que atuamos com clientes de diversos setores, desde bancos até o varejo. Se você deseja ampliar sua base de conhecimento ou focar e se especializar em um setor específico, encontrará sua oportunidade aqui. Você também terá a chance de compartilhar sua experiência recomendando opções de modernização, identificando novas oportunidades de negócios e cultivando relacionamentos com outras equipes e partes interessadas. O trabalho pode ser desafiador às vezes? Sim! Mas você colaborará com um grupo diverso de pessoas talentosas e desenvolverá habilidades valiosas de gestão e organização, que serão úteis ao longo da sua carreira.

Seu futuro na Kyndryl: Toda posição na Kyndryl oferece um caminho para o crescimento profissional, desde Administrador de Sistemas Júnior até Arquiteto. Temos oportunidades com provedores de nuvem (Cloud Hyperscalers) que você não encontrará em nenhum outro lugar, incluindo experiência prática, oportunidades de aprendizado e a chance de obter certificações nas quatro principais plataformas. Um dos benefícios de trabalhar na Kyndryl é justamente essa diversidade de setores com os quais atuamos, permitindo que você escolha entre ampliar seu conhecimento ou se especializar em uma área específica.

Who You Are

Você é bom no que faz e tem a experiência necessária para provar isso. Equilíbrio entre experiência e mentalidade de crescimento, sendo motivado a impulsionar seu próprio desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Você é focado no cliente – alguém que prioriza o sucesso do cliente em seu trabalho. E, por fim, você é aberto e sem fronteiras – naturalmente inclusivo na forma como trabalha com os outros.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitoração e resolução de problemas dos jobs do ambiente de produção (execução e recursos)
  • Monitoração e resolução de problemas dos jobs de usuário com tempo de execução excedido
  • Monitoração dos jobs de taxa de câmbio
  • Monitoração e resolução de problemas de file system (SO)
  • Monitoração e resolução de problemas nos sistemas/instâncias ABAP/JAVA
  • Cópia/Refresh de Mandante
  • Bloqueio de transação e criação de job
  • Utilização do sistema SAP LVM para manutenção em sistemas SAP
  • Análise de problema de transporte
  • Manutenção programada do sistema SAP (Petronect)
  • Monitoração de expiração de certificado digital do processo de negócio
  • Monitoração dos serviços SAP em ambiente on-premisse
  • Monitoração dos serviços SAP em ambiente de nuvem
  • Cadastramento de Estação e usuários no sistema IXOS
  • Execução de Rotinas operacionais Diárias e Semanais
  • Atendimento de incidentes de usuários/monitoração pela ferramenta disponibilizada pela PETROBRAS (ITSM)

Informações importantes

  • Disponibilidade para atuação em regime de turnos (12x36)
  • Local de atuação: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (100% presencial)

Experiência Técnica e Profissional Necessária

  • Formação Superior completa na área de Tecnologia da Informação, Administração ou Engenharia
  • Experiência com SAP

Experiência Técnica e Profissional Desejável

  • Conhecimento em ITIL, processos de gestão de incidentes e problemas
  • Curso Oficial SAPTEC - Fundamentos de tecnologia do SAP S/4HANA e SAP Business Suite
  • Domínio na língua Inglesa e Espanhola

Being You

A “Kyn” in Kyndryl significa kinship, que representa os fortes laços que temos uns com os outros, nossos clientes e nossas comunidades. Nós focamos em garantir que todos os Kyndryls se sintam incluídos e damos as boas-vindas a pessoas de todas as culturas, origens e experiências. Mesmo que você não atenda a todos os requisitos, incentivamos que se candidate. Acreditamos no crescimento e estamos empolgados para ver o que você pode trazer.

What You Can Expect

Seu carreira conosco não é apenas um trabalho – é uma aventura com propósito. Oferecemos uma cultura dinâmica e híbrida que apoia seu bem-estar e lhe dá a oportunidade de crescer. Nossos programas Be Well são projetados para apoiar sua saúde financeira, mental, física e social – porque sabemos que quando você se sente melhor, faz melhor.

A partir do seu primeiro dia, você mergulhará em projetos de impacto que o fazem crescer e evoluir. Estamos aqui para apoiar sua jornada com ferramentas poderosas, metas de desenvolvimento personalizadas e feedback contínuo.

Você desenvolve habilidades em demanda e busca certificações com Microsoft, Google e Amazon, e outras oportunidades de aprendizado.

title: Certification Social Assessor (Mining)
description:
Lead credibility where it matters most. Shape how the global mining and metals sector demonstrates responsible, ethical, and socially sound performance.

Why This Role Matters

As global scrutiny on mining and metals intensifies—from investors, communities, regulators, and Indigenous Peoples—credible, independent assurance has never been more critical. In this executive‑level technical role, you will sit at the intersection of social performance, human rights, and operational accountability, ensuring mining organizations meet internationally recognized standards while building trust with affected stakeholders. Your expertise will directly support responsible resource development and meaningful social outcomes across global supply chains.

What Your Impact Is

  • Serve as a trusted authority delivering high‑quality certification and assurance audits against leading sustainability, social, and management system standards.
  • Strengthen client credibility on human rights, labor practices, Indigenous engagement, and grievance mechanisms.
  • Influence better industry outcomes by shaping audit findings into clear, actionable insights for senior decision‑makers.
  • Help evolve ERM CVS’s assurance methodologies, raising the bar across the mining and metals sector worldwide.

Required

What You’ll Bring

  • A Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in international development, social sciences, law, public policy, anthropology, resource management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience in social impact assessment (SIA), FPIC, Indigenous Peoples’ rights, resettlement, or social performance within mining or related sectors.
  • Proven audit experience, including:
    • A minimum of 10 audits, or
    • 3+ years where auditing represents at least 25% of professional responsibilities within the last 5 years.
  • Practical exposure to on‑site mining or minerals operations.
  • Strong working knowledge of social and ESG standards, including:
    • IFC Performance Standards, SA8000, ILO conventions
    • UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights
    • OECD Due Diligence Guidance and related frameworks
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and explain complex findings to technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%.

Preferred

  • Lead Auditor qualification for ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, and/or ISO 50001.
  • Hands‑on experience with voluntary mining standards such as IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM Mining Principles, ASI, RMI, or the Consolidated Mining Standard.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17021 accreditation requirements.
  • Multilingual capability, particularly English, Spanish, and Portuguese (additional languages such as French or Bahasa are an asset).
  • Experience mentoring auditors or supporting technical capability development within certification or assurance teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver third‑party certification and assurance audits across international standards, including ISO frameworks, IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM, ASI, and related social and ESG criteria.
  • Evaluate client conformance, performance, and maturity across management systems and social performance requirements.
  • Lead audit planning, execution, and reporting within multi‑disciplinary teams, ensuring methodological rigor and consistency.
  • Prepare clear, high‑quality audit reports that articulate findings, non‑conformities, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Engage directly with client leadership, workforce representatives, communities, and Indigenous stakeholders in line with audit protocols.
  • Manage certification projects end‑to‑end, balancing scope, schedule, quality, and budget.
  • Act as the primary client interface throughout the project lifecycle, building trusted advisory relationships.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of ERM CVS methodologies, tools, and technical guidance.
  • Support business development through pre‑audit consultations, proposal inputs, and thought leadership.
  • Mentor and support developing auditors, strengthening capability within the assurance team.

About ERM Certification And Verification Services (CVS)

ERM CVS is a global leader in certification, assurance, and verification services , partnering with organizations to demonstrate compliance, strengthen ESG performance, and build stakeholder trust. We specialize in ISO certification and sustainability assurance across sectors including Mining, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Technology, and Pharmaceuticals , supporting clients to meet the highest international standards with confidence and credibility.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

description:
Business Analyst | Pleno (Growth & Canais Digitais) | Híbrido SP ou RJ

São Paulo, São Paulo, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o empreendedor brasileiro e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa razão.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele, é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Business Analyst (Growth & Canais Digitais)

No seu dia a dia, você vai realizar:

  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time de análise, garantindo a manutenção e evolução das tabelas gerenciais de resultados, além de conduzir agendas técnicas com os times de Dados e Engenharia;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos membros mais juniores do time, com foco em SQL, boas práticas analíticas e construção de raciocínio de negócio;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar estruturas de dados e processos de inteligência, permitindo tomadas de decisão mais ágeis e em tempo real, reduzindo dependências manuais;
  • Construir e evoluir agentes e estruturas automatizadas de report, aumentando a eficiência operacional e a escalabilidade das análises;
  • Garantir a documentação e organização do conhecimento da área, mantendo dicionários de dados e bases de conhecimento sempre atualizados;
  • Estruturar o contexto de negócio que alimenta os agentes de IA da área, assegurando consistência nas análises e autonomia para que diferentes membros do time consigam navegar e interpretar as tabelas de resultado com facilidade.

O que esperamos de você

  • SQL Avançado: Domínio completo na manipulação de grandes bases de dados (BigQuery e Databricks), além de experiência com otimização de queries complexas;
  • Prompt Engineering & AI Savvy: Experiência prática utilizando ferramentas como "ChatGPT", Gemini e Claude para acelerar fluxos de trabalho, incluindo análise de dados, escrita de código e estruturação de problemas.

title: X-Ray & Mammography Technologist
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Under the direction of the Sr. Clinical Practice Manager for Benning Road and the Director of Operations for Surgical Subspecialties, the X‑Ray & Mammography Technologist will perform diagnostic exams for the Breast Surgery, Orthopedics, Surgical Oncology, and other assigned specialties.

General Summary

X‑Ray Tech

  • Performs a full range of diagnostic radiographic examinations in the department, clinics, and operating room. Ensures radiation safety precautions are taken. Adheres to the policies and procedures that apply to the performance of obtaining radiographic studies, including performing a correct exam, including laterality, on the correct patient at the time requested.
  • Provides basic information to patients and/or families about procedures to be performed and can answer questions if asked. Assists the Radiologists in performing special radiological examinations. Assists with the upkeep of radiographic equipment and adheres to all related safety requirements and reports needed for equipment repairs.
  • Ensures timely completion of all exams through tracking, scanning, and other technical workflow as related to Radiology Information System (RIS, Enterprise Radiology Solutions (ERS), and Enterprise Electronic Record (EMR (Electronic Medical Record)). Operates digital and fluoroscopic radiographic equipment.
  • Participates in orientation and other opportunities for learning as delegated by the department, other hospital staff, and students. Exemplifies SPIRIT values, and actively participates in Patient Safety Standards and tasks.
  • Coordinates and collaborates with Technical Aides to ensure efficient room turnover. Coordinates, communicates, and collaborates with Patient Financial Associates that register radiology exams to minimize delays and potential safety issues for the outpatient population.

Mammo Tech

  • Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Imaging principles, theory, anatomy, and pathology processes while utilizing the most appropriate techniques and/or positioning for optimal examinations, as demonstrated by exam results.
  • Communicates effectively with patients to obtain clinical history/informed consent from patients, or patients' charts, to assist the physician in optimizing the performance and interpretation of the examination, as evidenced by the exam results.
  • Demonstrates the effective use of radiation protection procedures with collimation devices and protective shielding, as evidenced by incident reports.
  • Maintains an orderly, safe, and clean environment. Ensures rooms are stocked with appropriate supplies for procedures.
  • Performs and documents routine quality control testing of equipment. Performs/recognizes the need for routine maintenance of imagers/processors to maintain consistent quality images, as evidenced by the physician and exam results.

Minimum Education and Experience

Education

Graduate of an accredited school/program of radiography.

Experience

Minimum of 1 year of Imaging experience as a Rad tech in a hospital/healthcare environment; Must be able to perform in 2 or more modalities with an even amount of time spent rotating in each annually based on the needs of the unit.

Certification

ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) registered as a Radiologic Technologist. Must obtain advanced certification in applicable modality within 1 year of training; BLS certification preferred or achieved in first 90 days.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $75,454 - $83,000

description:
Descrição

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI`s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores, os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos, exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;
  • Promover eventualmente a integração dos novos colaboradores, apresentando os riscos a que estão expostos, ensinando os procedimentos e análises de riscos, fazendo um treinamento total, apresentação através de Power Point, dando palestras em sala de reuniões, apresentando-os aos seus Supervisores, para fins de mostrar os riscos aos novos colaboradores, apresentar-lhes as responsabilidades e obrigações dentro da empresa;
  • Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração;
  • Fiscalizar diariamente as Unidades, com o intuito de assegurar que o DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) está sendo cumprido, arquivando e assinando o DDS, para fins de promover a conscientização e prevenção de acidentes entre os colaboradores;
  • Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA;
  • Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;
  • Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências;
  • Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações.
  • Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida;
  • Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho;
  • Indicar e orientar a implementação de medidas preventivas de segurança em toda área industrial, administrativa e proteção ao meio ambiente;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Fazer plano de ação para cumprimento do Anexo SMS escopo do Contrato, apresentando evidências para PETROBRAS;
  • Participar de programas de auditorias de SMS, segurança industrial e de meio ambiente, acompanhar as atividades operacionais nas áreas contratuais, visando à segurança do profissional envolvido, bem patrimonial e meio ambiente;
  • Investigar a analisar acidentes e ocorrências anormais, planejando e executando Plano de Ação trazendo segurança nas operações;
  • Elaborar planos de contingência e coordenar atividades de controle de emergências para todas as áreas contratuais, proceder de acordo com os padrões técnicos e normas operacionais;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Registro MTE.
  • Atuação anterior na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho.
